message: No detected input validation: The code loads images and metadata without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards; load_image only branches on file extension but does not validate content, shape, or pixel range.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data and model checkpoints are loaded from local filesystem paths with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authenticated source handling.

No detected label flipping detection: The only label handling is `select_valid_labels` which filters out negative labels (>=0), but there is no check for unexpected label values, distribution anomalies, or label-noise detection tools.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code loads and normalizes images but performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or any other mechanism to detect or filter poisoned/suspicious training samples.
No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights via `pretrained_model_path=checkpoint_path` with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading.

No detected label distribution validation: The code filters labels with select_valid_labels() (>=0 check) but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanism is imported or used in any of the code slices.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or manual FGSM/PGD attack code anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: The code performs single-model inference and prints a severity score with no held-out test set isolation controls, hash/signature verification of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics.

No detected input sanitization: The load_image function simply reads and normalizes the image without checking shape, dimensions, data type validity, or rejecting malformed inputs before passing to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: After inference, the code directly computes severity from pred without any NaN checks, probability bounds validation, or sanity checks on the model output values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision model (ResNet on chest X-rays), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
